name: saramin-mcp
description: 사람인 Saramin (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_saramin_access_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SARAMIN_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_saramin_access_key.description: access-key issued after Saramin approves your API application (이용신청) and you register an app at https://oapi.saramin.co.kr/.

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET /job-search with Accept: application/json: keywords (company, title, keyword and duty text), start = 0-based page number, count ≤ 110 (default 10); fields=posting-date adds the ISO posting date. loc_cd takes region codes, so location is not sent. jobs.total is a string in the sample, so total is null. salary is a code + text range (in raw). Failures arrive as {code, message} (1/2 bad key, 3 bad parameter, 4 daily quota).
